briefings.title: CVE-2025-39964: Linux Kernel actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: Linux Kernel contains a race condition vulnerability which allows concurrent writes to the same AF_ALG socket causing data to be unpredictably interleaved and creating inconsistencies in the socket's internal state.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-53266: Linux Kernel actively exploited

briefings.title: CVE-2026-58704: Google Pixel actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: Google Pixel devices contain an improper authorization vulnerability in the cellular modem. A logic error may allow an attacker to bypass permission checks and escalate privileges.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-28326 — HIGH (CVSS 8.8)
briefings.excerpt: SolarWinds Access Rights Manager was reported to be affected by an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability. The issue stems from a hardcoded static key.
